import json
import kit

# ------------- composites as results, multiple entries, entries never merge
types = [
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
    {"name": "C", "kind": "char"},
    {"name": "S", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["lo", "I"], ["hi", "I"]]},
    {"name": "AS", "kind": "alias", "target": "S"},
    {"name": "AR", "kind": "array", "element": "C", "size": 3},
    {"name": "STR", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
]
modules = [
    {"name": "one", "params": [["p", "AS"]], "result": ["r", "S"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "two", "params": [["p", "S"]], "result": ["r", "AS"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "three", "params": [["c", "AR"], ["s", "STR"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": None},
]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["one", "two", "three"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
for plan in out["plans"]:
    print(plan["entry"], plan["types"], plan["slots"], plan["variables"])

plan_one, plan_two, plan_three = out["plans"]
assert plan_one["types"] == ["S", "AS"]
assert plan_two["types"] == ["S", "AS"]
# struct id then two ints, result struct id then two ints
assert [s[0] for s in plan_one["slots"]] == ["x1", "x2", "x4", "x5"]
assert plan_one["variables"] == 6

runs = []
# p = (1,2), r = (3,4)
def enc(plan, values):
    return kit.encode([(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
                       zip(plan["slots"], values)])

runs.append({"entry": "one", "ktest": enc(plan_one, [1, 2, 3, 4])})
runs.append({"entry": "two", "ktest": enc(plan_two, [1, 2, 3, 4])})   # same values
out = dict(campaign, runs=runs)
result = kit.run_cli(out)
print(result["records"])
print(result["corpus"])
assert [r["status"] for r in result["records"]] == ["READY", "READY"]
assert result["records"][0]["model_result"] == {"lo": 3, "hi": 4}
assert len(result["corpus"]) == 2   # never merge different entries

# three: chars and a string with no NUL
runs = [{"entry": "three", "ktest": enc(plan_three, [65, 66, 0, 97, 98, 99])},
        {"entry": "three", "ktest": enc(plan_three, [0, 66, 0, 97, 0, 99])}]
out = dict(campaign, runs=runs)
result = kit.run_cli(out)
print(result["records"], result["corpus"])
assert result["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"c": ["A", "B", "\x00"], "s": "abc"}
assert result["corpus"][1]["inputs"] == {"c": ["\x00", "B", "\x00"], "s": "a"}
assert result["corpus"][0]["model_result"] if False else True

# ------------- leaf range validation -------------------------------------
bad_cases = []
runs = [{"entry": "three", "ktest": enc(plan_three, [65, 66, 2, 97, 98, 99])}]  # bool? no, char
bad_cases.append(("char ok actually", plan_three, [65, 66, 255, 97, 98, 99], "READY"))
bad_cases.append(("int padding", plan_one, [1, 2 ** 16, 3, 4], "INVALID_TEST"))
bad_cases.append(("int ok", plan_one, [1, 2 ** 16 - 1, 3, 4], "READY"))
for label, plan, values, want in bad_cases:
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": [plan["entry"]], "machine": None,
                "runs": [{"entry": plan["entry"], "ktest": enc(plan, values)}]}
    got = kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]["status"]
    print(label, got, want)
    assert got == want

# ------------- wrong width / missing object -------------------------------
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["one"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [{"entry": "one", "ktest": kit.encode(
                [("x1", b"\x01\x01"), ("x2", b"\x02\x02"), ("x4", b"\x03"), ("x5", b"\x04\x04")])}]}
got = kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]["status"]
print("width", got); assert got == "INVALID_TEST"

campaign = dict(campaign, runs=[{"entry": "one", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [("x1", b"\x01\x01"), ("x2", b"\x02\x02"), ("x4", b"\x03\x03")])}])
got = kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]["status"]
print("missing", got); assert got == "INVALID_TEST"

# object_count lying about the actual pairs
campaign = dict(campaign, runs=[{"entry": "one", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [("x1", b"\x01\x01"), ("x2", b"\x02\x02"), ("x4", b"\x03\x03"), ("x5", b"\x04\x04")],
    object_count=3)}])
got = kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]["status"]
print("count", got); assert got == "INVALID_TEST"
print("MISC OK")
PYEOF
